2.

This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner praying for fair investigation in Case Crime
No.378 of 2024, under Section 376 of Ipc at Police Station- Mauranipur, District - Jhansi.
3.  This petition is disposed of directing the investigating officer to conclude the investigation within 60 days from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
